E is the midpoint of DB:
\[
E=\left(\frac{b+2b}{2},0\right)=\left(\frac{3b}{2},0\right)
\]
F is the midpoint of BC:
\[
F=(b+c,d)
\]
Area of \(\triangle ABC = \frac12(2b)(2d)=2bd=96\), so \(bd=48\).

Area of \(\triangle AEF\):
\[
\frac12 \cdot \frac{3b}{2} \cdot d = \frac{3bd}{4} = \frac{3(48)}{4}=36
\]

\[
\boxed{36}
\]
